issues.where: the purple streamers trailing off the spire tips
issues.what: the plumes read as flat glossy ribbons with banded lines and holes, like extruded plastic, not vapour or spray; they cast no light and take none from the bolts passing through them
issues.fix: replace with volumetric, soft-edged plumes that scatter the lightning and fade into the air

issues.where: the spires and the snow-capped mounds they stand on
issues.what: faceted low-poly geometry with one stretched mottled texture on everything; the snow is smeared and streaked down the slopes and the spires sit on the mounds with no join
issues.fix: add real geometric detail and layered rock and snow materials, with snow banked where the spire meets the base

issues.what: they look like smooth models wrapped in stiff fur cards; the fur on the left animal is streaked and smeared, the near ones float over the water and there is no wet or contact with it
issues.fix: groom real fur, plant the feet in the water with ripples and wet fur at the legs, and add contact shadows

issues.what: one repeating streaked texture stretched over a smooth tube; it softens and smears where the camera is close
issues.fix: model real rock or ice relief and use close-range texture that holds detail

issues.where: the water floor of the cave
issues.what: flat sheet with regular orange ring speckles and no wet edge or foam against the walls or legs; the reflection reads as a tiled pattern
issues.fix: give the water depth, proper reflections of walls and animals, and edges where it meets rock and legs

issues.where: left animal, x 0 to 17% y 58 to 75%
issues.what: a round dark eye-like shape with a dotted pattern shows on the animal; the animals are meant to have no eyes
issues.fix: remove the eye form from the model

issues.where: the dark cables from the spires and the stepped dark seams on the spire faces
issues.what: thin black lines and stair-step dark bands read as geometry seams and wire meshes, not rock
issues.fix: remove the stray lines and close the mesh seams

issues.where: the storm cloud, x 83 to 100% y 25 to 42%
issues.what: cloud is a soft blurred flat tint with no internal light or structure; the far mountains are flat cutout layers with hard edges
issues.fix: use volumetric cloud with lit edges from the lightning and atmospheric depth on the far ridges

issues.where: the lightning strike on the near spire
issues.what: bright bolt and spark burst light nothing around them; the spire, cloud and streamers show no flash
issues.fix: have the strike light the spire tip, the cloud base and the plume

issues.where: the horizon and the plain below the sky, x 83 to 100% y 58 to 75%
issues.what: flat grey ground meets a flat sky gradient with a hard edge and a cut-out silhouette; no air or detail in the distance
issues.fix: add terrain detail and aerial perspective at the horizon

issues.where: water and walls at the cave mouth
issues.what: the water is a flat striped plane that meets the wall along a straight hard line; the wall texture is smeared vertical streaks
issues.fix: break up the water surface, add a wet edge and reflections at the wall, and give the wall real relief

issues.what: fur renders as dithered pixel strands with aliasing
issues.fix: render fur with proper filtering and sampling
